# Callers and the backend service

Read from the code: every public name below, its signature and its docstring. Import `igni_extension` — defined in `igni_extension.caller`, `igni_extension.service`, `igni_extension.tokens`.

| Name | What it is |
|---|---|
| [`Caller`](#caller) | The producer one call is for. |
| [`CallerKind`](#callerkind) | Who a call is for: a person, an app, or one end user of an app (a space). |
| [`NoCaller`](#nocaller) | Asked for the caller outside a call igni made: in `on_start` work, say. |
| [`ServiceClient`](#serviceclient) | `ext.service`: the extension's service, as the signed-in person. |
| [`SignedIn`](#signedin) | Who the last token was for, read without checking it. |

## Caller

```python
class Caller(BaseModel)
Caller(
    *,
    kind: CallerKind,
    id: str,
    org: str | None = None,
    group: str | None = None,
    session: str | None = None,
    app: str | None = None,
    external_id: str | None = None,
)
```

The producer one call is for.

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `kind` | `CallerKind` | required | `person`, `app` or `space`. |
| `id` | `str` | required | The person's or the app's id on igni server. |
| `org` | `str \| None` | `None` | Their organisation. |
| `group` | `str \| None` | `None` | The one group a person belongs to in `org`; an app has none. |
| `session` | `str \| None` | `None` | The igni session the call comes from, when there is one. |
| `app` | `str \| None` | `None` | A space's app (its id); `None` for a person or an app. |
| `external_id` | `str \| None` | `None` | The app's own name for a space's end user. |

## NoCaller

```python
class NoCaller(LookupError)
```

## ServiceClient

```python
class ServiceClient(AsyncClient)
ServiceClient(
    *,
    base_url: str,
    tokens: HostTokens,
    transport: httpx.AsyncBaseTransport | None = None,
    timeout: float = 30.0,
)
```

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `base_url` | `str` | required | The service's base URL, as igni set it: `http://service.test`. |
| `tokens` | `HostTokens` | required | The person's tokens for the service, which every request carries. |
| `transport` | `httpx.AsyncBaseTransport \| None` | `None` | The HTTP transport the service is reached through, so a test can answer it. |
| `timeout` | `float` | `30.0` | Seconds to wait for the service before giving up. |

`ext.service`: the extension's service, as the signed-in person.

### ServiceClient.for_()

```python
def for_(caller: Caller) -> ServiceClient
```

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `caller` | `Caller` | required | The producer the service is reached as: the person a tool was handed. |

The same service, as `caller`: what a tool acting for someone uses.

The token is fetched from the host for that caller, and kept apart
from every other caller's. The service sees exactly who the call
is for, as it checks every token.

### ServiceClient.anonymous

```python
@property
anonymous: httpx.AsyncClient
```

The same service, with no token: for what anyone may read.

### ServiceClient.websocket()

```python
def websocket(path: str, **options: Any) -> ServiceWebSocket
```

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `path` | `str` | required | The path on the service, relative to its base URL: `/v1/rooms/runbook`. |
| `options` | `Any` | required | The options the WebSocket connection takes, as `websockets.asyncio.client.connect` spells them. |

A WebSocket to `path` on the service, with the person's token.

`options` go to `websockets.asyncio.client.connect`.

### ServiceClient.aclose()

```python
async def aclose() -> None
```

Close this client, and the clients `for_(caller)` made.

## SignedIn

```python
class SignedIn(BaseModel)
SignedIn(*, user_id: str = '', org_id: str = '', email: str = '', name: str = '')
```

Who the last token was for, read without checking it.

For showing who is signed in and noticing that it changed. The service
checks the token; this side never decides anything with what it says.

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `user_id` | `str` | `''` | The person's igni user id. |
| `org_id` | `str` | `''` | The organisation the token is for. |
| `email` | `str` | `''` | Their email address, when the token carries it. |
| `name` | `str` | `''` | Their name, when the token carries it. |

### SignedIn.of()

```python
@classmethod
def of(token: str) -> SignedIn
```

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `token` | `str` | required | The person's token for this extension's service, as the host handed it over. |

Who `token` names, read from its claims without checking its signature.

Every field is empty for a token that is not a JWT.
